history.title: OPERATION HISTORY
guide.intro: Use a data-capable cable — some cables only charge
guide.1.title: 01  •  Prepare ADB on your computer
guide.1.body: Download SDK Platform-Tools from Android's website, extract the entire ZIP and click “Choose ADB” to select adb.exe — keep the tool's DLLs in the same folder
guide.2.title: 02  •  Enable USB debugging
guide.2.body: On Android, open Developer options and enable “USB debugging” — the location of these settings varies by manufacturer
guide.3.title: 03  •  Authorize the computer
guide.3.body: Connect the cable, unlock the screen and accept the USB debugging request — then return to the device list
guide.4.title: 04  •  Check the driver and state
guide.4.body: On Windows, the device may need its manufacturer's USB driver — “offline” means the connection is unavailable and “unauthorized” requires confirmation on the phone
guide.limit: If Android cannot start or debugging was not authorized, ADB entry may be unavailable — consult the manufacturer's button instructions for the exact model
roadmap.intro: What works now and what will be built in the next stages
roadmap.1.title: 0.1  •  Android — implemented
roadmap.1.body: ADB detection, device selection, normal restart, Recovery entry, reconnection monitoring and local history
roadmap.2.title: 0.2  •  Bootloader and Samsung — planned
roadmap.2.body: Fastboot, Fastbootd and Download Mode with compatibility verified per model — Download Mode is not detected by ADB
roadmap.3.title: 0.3  •  iPhone — planned
roadmap.3.body: Dedicated libimobiledevice and libirecovery integration, Recovery and a model-specific DFU guide — iPhone uses its own protocols, separate from ADB
roadmap.note: This version only controls the Android functions listed in stage 0.1
